Eight comments

Old Man Quinn

Here’s a nice three part hornpipe from the O’Neill’s collection. I especially like the two triplet figures leading into rolls in the second two parts.

↳ Posted by radriano on October 1st, 2003.

Good post!

I have been playing this for a few years and have never met any one else who knew it. A really good tune.

↳ Posted by Geoff Pollitt on October 3rd, 2003.
